subject: Foods and Nutrition
examFormat: Three papers, all to be taken; Papers 1 and 2 form a composite paper taken at one sitting. Paper 1: sixty multiple choice questions in 1 hour for 60 marks. Paper 2: six essay questions, four to be answered, 1 hour 15 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 3: practical test of 3 hours for 100 marks, conducted by a visiting examiner.

subtopics.name: Introduction to Foods and Nutrition
objectives: Explain the meaning of foods and nutrition
Describe the basic knowledge of nutrition
State the importance of human nutrition
Identify the factors affecting foods and nutrition
Describe food habits

subtopics.name: Careers associated with Foods and Nutrition
objectives: Identify careers associated with foods and nutrition
State the factors that influence career choices
State the characteristics required for foods and nutrition careers

subtopics.name: Basic Food Nutrients
objectives: State the nutrients and their nutritive values
Describe the functions of the different nutrients
Identify the sources of the different nutrients
Describe dietary deficiencies
Describe the metabolism (digestion and absorption) of carbohydrate, protein and fat
Use a food composition table
Carry out simple physical and chemical tests on food stuffs to detect nutrients such as proteins, fats and carbohydrates

subtopics.name: Meal Planning
objectives: Explain meal planning terms
State the reasons for planning meals
Identify the factors in planning meals
State the general principles of meal planning
Describe meal patterns

subtopics.name: Special Nutritional Needs
objectives: Describe the nutritional needs of different groups, e.g. pregnant and lactating mothers, infants and children, adolescents, adults and the aged, vegetarians
Plan meals for people in health conditions, e.g. HIV and AIDS, invalids, convalescents, overweight, underweight, hypertension, diabetes

subtopics.name: The Kitchen
objectives: Identify types of kitchen, e.g. traditional, modern, institutional
Plan different types of kitchen
State the factors to consider when planning a kitchen
Identify cleaning agents and abrasives (commercial and local)

subtopics.name: Kitchen Equipment and Tools
objectives: Classify equipment and identify its types
Select, use, care for and store large and small equipment, fixtures and appliances

subtopics.name: Safety in the Kitchen
objectives: Identify types of kitchen accidents
State the causes and prevention of accidents
State the content and use of the first aid box
Give simple first aid treatment

subtopics.name: Sanitation in the Kitchen
objectives: Describe personal hygiene
Describe kitchen hygiene, e.g. general cleaning, waste disposal, pests and pest control
Describe food hygiene, e.g. handling of foods, food borne diseases, food sanitation laws

subtopics.name: Animal and Animal Products
objectives: Describe the kinds/types and structure of milk and milk products (e.g. cheese, yoghurt), eggs, meat, poultry and fish
Describe the selection and storage of animal products

subtopics.name: Cereals and Grains
objectives: Identify the kinds and forms of cereals and grains
State the importance of cereals and grains: versatility, thickening, cheap source of energy and good source of roughage

subtopics.name: Fruits and Vegetables
objectives: Classify fruits and vegetables
Describe the structure, nutritive value and storage of fruits and vegetables
State the importance of fruits and vegetables in the diet

subtopics.name: Legumes and Oily Seeds
objectives: Classify legumes and oily seeds
State the importance of legumes and oily seeds in the diet

subtopics.name: Fats and Oils
objectives: Classify fats and oils into vegetable and animal fats and oils
State the uses of fats and oils in the diet and in the body
State the health implications of fats and oils

subtopics.name: Starchy Roots and Plantain
objectives: Identify types of starchy roots
Identify types of plantain
Identify types of dishes from starchy roots and plantain

subtopics.name: Food Spoilage
objectives: Explain the meaning of food spoilage
State the causes and agents of food spoilage

subtopics.name: Food Preservation
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of preservation
State the general principles underlying food preservation
Describe methods of food preservation

subtopics.name: Food Storage
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of food storage
Describe the storage of perishable and non perishable foods
Identify storage space and equipment, e.g. refrigeration, deep freezer, cupboards, shelves, granaries, barns

subtopics.name: Principles Underlying Cooking
objectives: Explain the concept of cooking
State the reasons for cooking food

subtopics.name: Methods of Cooking
objectives: Describe moist heat methods, e.g. boiling, stewing, steaming
Describe dry heat methods, e.g. baking, roasting, grilling, frying
State the effects of heat on different food commodities, e.g. animal products, cereals and grains, fats and oils

subtopics.name: Transfer of Heat
objectives: Explain the methods of heat transfer: convection (liquids, gases), radiation (space) and conduction (solid metal)

subtopics.name: Cooking Terms
objectives: Explain cooking terms

subtopics.name: Food Additives
objectives: Define food additives
Identify the types of food additives
State the functions of additives
Describe the selection and use of additives
Explain food adulteration

subtopics.name: Flour Cookery and Confectionery
objectives: Identify types of flour, ingredients in flour and uses of flour
State the basic ingredients in flour cookery: flour, fat, sugar, eggs
Identify raising agents (steam, carbon dioxide and air) and their sources: boiling liquid (steam), baking powder (carbon dioxide), whisking (air)

subtopics.name: Batters and Doughs
objectives: Identify the types and uses of batters and prepare dishes using batter
Prepare doughs and cakes by the rubbed in, creamed, whisked, melted and sponge methods, and classify biscuits

subtopics.name: Pastries
objectives: Identify types of pastries, e.g. shortcrust, suet, flaky
State the principles underlying pastry making
Prepare pastry dishes, e.g. turnover, jam tartlets, cornish pasties

subtopics.name: Yeast Mixtures
objectives: Define yeast mixtures
Describe ways of preparing yeast mixtures
State important points in preparing yeast mixtures
Prepare yeast dishes: bread loaves, bread rolls, doughnuts

subtopics.name: Cake Decoration
objectives: Identify types of icing, e.g. butter icing, royal icing
State the uses of icing
Prepare icing
Use royal icing and butter icing

subtopics.name: Classification of Beverages
objectives: Classify beverages into non-alcoholic (coffee and tea, cocoa drink, milk and egg drinks, fruit juices and fruit drinks, beef tea and lemon grass) and alcoholic (beer, wine)

subtopics.name: Importance of Beverages
objectives: State the importance of beverages, including nutritive values

subtopics.name: Principles Underlying Preparation of Beverages
objectives: State the principles underlying the preparation of beverages such as tea, coffee and cocoa

topics.name: Convenience Foods
objectives: Identify types of convenience foods
Describe the selection and uses of convenience foods
State the advantages and disadvantages of using convenience foods
Prepare dishes using convenience foods

topics.name: Rechauffe (Leftover) Foods
objectives: Explain rechauffe (leftover) foods
State the importance of using leftover foods
State the rules/guidelines for using leftover foods
Prepare rechauffe dishes

topics.name: Festive Dishes / Special Occasion Dishes
objectives: Explain festive dishes
Identify occasions for festive dishes
Identify types of festive/special occasion dishes
Prepare festive/special occasion dishes

subtopics.name: Entertainment
objectives: Explain entertainment
Identify types of parties and occasions for parties
State the points to consider when selecting types of parties
State the factors that contribute to the success of parties

subtopics.name: Table Setting and Etiquette
objectives: Explain table setting and cover
Set tables and trays for different meals and occasions
Identify table appointments
Observe table manners/etiquette

subtopics.name: Meal Service Style
objectives: Identify types of meal service: informal and formal
State the factors determining choice of service style and type of party
Identify foods for special occasions, e.g. birthday, naming ceremonies, weddings

subtopics.name: Research into Local Dishes and Drinks
objectives: State the importance of research in foods and nutrition
Collect information (data)
Carry out research into local dishes
Develop new recipes
Improve existing recipes based on methods of preparation, nutritive value, time and energy use and service/presentation

subtopics.name: Experiments
objectives: Carry out experiments using fruits, e.g. passion fruit, samia, royal palm fruit
Carry out experiments using other types of flour, e.g. root, cereal and legumes

subtopics.name: Consumer Education (Meaning and Principles)
objectives: Explain the meaning and principles of consumer education
Identify consumer agents

subtopics.name: Food Budgeting

State the factors to consider when budgeting

subtopics.name: Food Purchasing

State the advantages and disadvantages of bulk purchasing

subtopics.name: Setting up and Managing a Catering Enterprise
objectives: Explain the terms entrepreneur, entrepreneurship and enterprise

State the advantages and disadvantages of an entrepreneur

subtopics.name: Work Ethics

subtopics.name: Packaging
